claim.summary: Over F2, coordinate interpolation defects D_j=I-L_j act diagonally on the free basis x^epsilon b^alpha, b_j=x_j^2+x_j. E_t=sum_(|T|=t) product_(j in T)D_j has eigenvalue binom(|supp alpha|,t) mod2. If f is in the ideal J_s generated by products of s distinct b_j and binom(s,t) is odd, M=f+E_t f lies in J_(s+1). E_t f has an explicit linear-placeholder Boolean correction of size O(binom(v,t)[3^t(S+v+t+1)]^4), depth at most 4delta+20 from size-S depth-delta f. For P=product_i(1+F_i) in J_s with binom(s,t) odd, every supplied refutation C linear in the full placeholder tuple can be patched to A+MC, with A determined only by the inputs and these corrections; all coordinate restrictions with at most s free variables agree with A. Polynomial overhead for fixed t; no exact Frege-image realization or unconditional small refutation.

No PC-degree, multilinearity-in-x or extension-field preservation is claimed.
